nodes.label: Automatic Mixed Precision (AMP)
nodes.rationale: Active for phases 1-2 only; disabled for the QAT phase because quantization observers are incompatible with mixed precision.

nodes.label: CBAM Attention
nodes.rationale: Inserted after backbone stage 3 so channel+spatial attention refines mid-level features before the deeper stages and pooling head.

nodes.label: Masked Multi-Task Loss
nodes.rationale: w_bin*CE_bin + w_cat*CE_cat + w_buf*CE_buf: each batch contributes only to the head(s) whose labels are present, so cattle and buffalo samples share one training loop.

nodes.label: EMA_DECAY
nodes.rationale: Phase-2 exponential moving average applied to parameters AND BN buffers so validation/inference uses smoothed statistics.

nodes.label: SAMPLER_BETA
nodes.rationale: Effective-number-of-samples sampler beta=0.999 counteracts class imbalance from breeds with very few images (e.g. limousin=5).

nodes.label: EfficientNet-Lite backbone
nodes.rationale: Lite variant uses relu6 MBConv blocks with no SE, and provides forward_until/forward_from splits so attention can be inserted mid-network. Pretrained .pth weights are shipped in-repo to avoid training from scratch and the accuracy loss that follows.

nodes.label: 3-head multi-task learning
nodes.rationale: Binary species head plus species-specific breed heads with masks; fixed head sizes across all data modes keep the architecture identical so smoke-test results are a valid proxy for full training.

nodes.label: Colab T4 GPU
nodes.rationale: 15 GB VRAM target; batch_size 64 with grad_accum 2 (effective 128), 2 workers, prefetch 4, pin_memory, dataset on local SSD not Drive.

nodes.label: Knowledge Distillation
nodes.rationale: A larger lite4 teacher transfers accuracy into the deployable lite2 student, trading a heavy teacher run for a small mobile model.

nodes.label: local_train.py Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fully automated 8-stage pipeline (prerequisites -> venv -> dataset -> verify -> train -> export) wraps the core engine so a single command reproduces a full local run.

nodes.label: src.parity_check Export Parity Gate
nodes.rationale: Compares fp32 PyTorch against mobile artifacts on identical data and enforces a tolerance so quantization regressions are caught before deployment.

nodes.label: Phase 3 QAT
nodes.rationale: QAT is opt-in and framed as a recovery tool; production mobile INT8 comes from converter PTQ, so QAT stays disabled by default to keep the pipeline shorter and more stable.

nodes.label: src.export Model Export
nodes.rationale: Multiple export modes (portable/onnx/onnx-int8/tflite/float16) because desktop testing and Android deployment need different runtimes; x86 int8 was removed as unusable on Android.

nodes.label: KD_ALPHA
nodes.rationale: Blend factor (1-alpha)*hard CE + alpha*T^2*KL(teacher||student) controlling how strongly the lite4 teacher guides the lite2 student.

nodes.label: GPU VRAM Auto-Scaling
nodes.rationale: On a 4.0 GB RTX 3050 the pipeline auto-picks batch_size=16 with grad_accum=8 to reach an effective batch of 128 without OOM.

nodes.label: INT8 Conversion per_channel_affine Failure
nodes.rationale: torch INT8 conversion aborts with 'Unsupported qscheme: per_channel_affine', motivating the shift to converter-based PTQ for mobile artifacts.

nodes.label: QAT Phase Degradation
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 QAT drops val top1 from 0.5779 (Phase 2) to 0.4902, evidence that QAT damaged accuracy and justifying PTQ as the production quantization path.

nodes.label: QAT Checkpoint Export Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Exporting the QAT checkpoint fails because the plain BreedClassifier expects pre-fusion BN keys (_bn1/_bn2) while the QAT state_dict contains fused bn + fake_quant/observer keys; the exporter must fuse or strip QAT wrappers first.

nodes.label: Bharat Pashudhan App (BPA)
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition

nodes.label: CBAM attention module
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Placed after backbone stage 4 for discriminative anatomical localization; provides implicit localization without a detection stage, eliminating two-stage error propagation (F3). CBAM channel-attention sigmoid is not natively quantizable in all TFLite backends.

nodes.label: EfficientNet-Lite2 backbone
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: MobileNetV2 lacked compound scaling and could not separate subtle inter-breed features (root cause F1); EfficientNet-Lite2 provides the capacity required for 60-class fine-grained visual classification.

nodes.label: Guided image capture overlay
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Eliminates the explicit detection stage dependency, removing the YOLO crop quality gate at the cost of ~2 weeks of Android development.

nodes.label: Binary head + species-specific sub-heads
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical split reduces per-head class count from 60 to 35 cattle / 25 buffalo, directly lowering decision complexity; the binary head gates the prediction path and only two of three heads activate per image at inference.

nodes.label: Masked per-head loss
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Species masks ensure buffalo images never penalize the cattle head and vice versa; loss weights 0.50/0.25/0.25 should be validated on the held-out split.

nodes.label: Shared-backbone multi-head hierarchical architecture decision
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Chosen over incremental two-stage (Option A) and YOLOv8-Classify (Option C) because it fixes all five root causes (F1-F5) simultaneously; sharing the backbone computes the heavy Conv/MBConv layers once so two species models collapse from ~12 MB to ~2 MB, uniquely delivering more accuracy at less storage. Projected 83-87% test accuracy vs the 57.71% baseline against an 85% target.

nodes.label: MobileNetV2 backbone
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Lacks compound scaling; upgrading to MobileNetV3-L adds capacity but not compound scaling, so F1 remains.

nodes.label: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Replaces post-training INT8 quantization (root cause F2), which under 10x compression stripped floating-point precision at class decision boundaries.

nodes.label: Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) block
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Fallback for CBAM channel attention: width-1 conv SE block has equivalent expressiveness and is fully TFLite-compatible.

nodes.label: SIH 2025 Problem Statement 25004
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition

nodes.label: Two-stage YOLO-Nano + MobileNetV2 pipeline
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Reference SIH 2025 implementation achieving only 57.71% test accuracy; two-stage error propagation (F3) irreversibly corrupts classifier input from bad YOLO-Nano crops.

nodes.label: YOLO-Nano detector
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition

nodes.label: YOLOv8-Classify unified model (Option C)
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.rationale: Rejected because YOLO's classification head operates on stride-8/16 feature maps, losing fine-grained spatial detail critical for FGVC with 35+ visually similar classes; largest model of the three options despite lowest accuracy.

nodes.label: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.community_name: ADR-001: ML Architecture for Cattle & Buffalo Breed Recognition
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: ml architecture for cattle & buffalo breed recognition

nodes.label: Knowledge distillation (teacher-student)
nodes.rationale: A larger lite4 + CBAM teacher is distilled into the same-size lite2 student to gain accuracy without increasing on-device size/latency.

nodes.label: EMA (Exponential Moving Average)
nodes.rationale: Phase-2 EMA must update parameters AND BatchNorm running stats (num_batches_tracked hard-copied). Removing buffer sync corrupts every phase-2 checkpoint with stale BN statistics while validation still looks plausible.

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime Mobile INT8 (QDQ)
nodes.rationale: QDQ static quantization with per-channel weights, calibrated on real train images; gives ~7.1 MB vs ~25.7 MB fp32.

nodes.label: Export parity gate
nodes.rationale: INT8 artifacts must stay within 1 pt combined_top1 of fp32; otherwise ship the FP32 TFLite fallback emitted alongside.

nodes.label: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in recovery path only (off by default); mobile INT8 normally comes from converter-side PTQ. Uses per-tensor fake-quant observers (x86 per-channel default broke conversion). AMP must be disabled because quantization observers are incompatible with mixed precision.

nodes.label: Soft cross-entropy
nodes.rationale: CutMix/MixUp produce fractional labels (e.g. 60/40 breed mix), requiring soft label vectors. Hard one-hot labels are a special case and work identically with soft_ce.

nodes.label: TFLite INT8 (converter PTQ)
nodes.rationale: Full-integer PTQ calibrated on ~500 real train images. Static batch-1 [1,3,260,260] input with ImageNet normalization baked in, RGB float32 [0,1]. Must stay within 1 pt combined_top1 of fp32 or fall back to FP32 TFLite.

nodes.label: torch.compile
nodes.rationale: Crashes on Windows (no Triton) so src/train.py auto-falls back to eager on os.name == 'nt'. Reduce-overhead mode OOMs on 15 GB T4 because CUDA Graphs pre-allocate VRAM in the backward pass; default torch.compile avoids it.

nodes.label: Byte caching
nodes.rationale: CACHE_IMAGES stores raw JPEG bytes in RAM instead of decoded PIL.Image objects to prevent RAM OOM while still bypassing slow disk I/O after the first epoch.

nodes.label: WeightedRandomSampler
nodes.rationale: Uses effective-number-of-samples weighting (SAMPLER_BETA=0.999), a softened inverse-frequency scheme that avoids over-oversampling breeds with only a handful of images. Training-only; evaluation uses the natural distribution. Binary head additionally species-balanced per batch.

nodes.label: QAT internals (fuse conv-bn, per-tensor observers)
nodes.rationale: x86 per-channel default broke convert() with Unsupported qscheme: per_channel_affine; AMP disabled during QAT because observers do not support fp16.

nodes.label: Binary-head species balancing
nodes.rationale: Per-batch re-weighting neutralizes the ~57:18 breed-count species prior.

nodes.label: Effective-number-of-samples sampler
nodes.rationale: SAMPLER_BETA=0.999 softens over-oversampling of 5-image breeds compared with pure inverse-frequency weighting.

nodes.label: Critical EMA BatchNorm buffer bug fix
nodes.norm_label: critical ema batchnorm buffer bug fix
nodes.rationale: Before the fix every phase-2 checkpoint exported stale BN statistics, silently degrading validation accuracy and the deployed model.

nodes.label: Knowledge distillation (--teacher)
nodes.rationale: Train a lite4 teacher then distill into the unchanged lite2 student — teacher accuracy at zero on-device cost.

nodes.label: ImageNet normalization baked into mobile graphs
nodes.norm_label: imagenet normalization baked into mobile graphs
nodes.rationale: Mobile artifacts expect RGB float32 in [0,1] with ImageNet normalization baked in, so the Flutter engine's existing pixel/255 preprocessing is exactly correct with zero app changes.

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime Mobile INT8 export
nodes.rationale: QDQ static quantization (per-channel weights, INT8 activations) calibrated on real train images; runs with onnxruntime already a dependency.

nodes.label: Parity gate
nodes.rationale: Any INT8 artifact must stay within 1 pt combined_top1 of the fp32 reference; fall back to the FP32 TFLite file or revisit calibration if it fails.

nodes.label: Portable export bundle
nodes.rationale: Self-contained folder saving state_dict (not TorchScript), so loading requires the BreedClassifier class; for framework-free deployment use ONNX/TFLite.

nodes.label: TFLite full-integer INT8 export
nodes.rationale: Chain PyTorch -> ONNX (static batch 1) -> onnx2tf -> TFLite FP32 -> full-integer INT8 PTQ, per-channel weights, calibrated on up to 500 real train images with float32 [0,1] I/O.

nodes.label: Pretrained backbone weights included in repo
nodes.norm_label: pretrained backbone weights included in repo
nodes.rationale: efficientnet_lite2.pth (~24 MB) and efficientnet_lite4.pth (~50 MB) track in git so no separate download is needed; without them the backbone trains from scratch with significantly worse accuracy.

nodes.label: Data modes (full/half/quarter/smoke)
nodes.rationale: Subset modes keep all 75 breed class maps so model architecture is identical to full training; deterministic sampling seed=42 for reproducibility.

nodes.label: VRAM auto-scaling
nodes.rationale: Adjusts batch_size and grad_accum to maintain a constant effective batch size of 128 across GPUs ranging from 4 GB to 24 GB+.

nodes.label: CutMix / MixUp batch mixing
nodes.rationale: Strong regularization on GPU; applied 50% of steps with CutMix(alpha=1.0) / MixUp(alpha=0.3).

nodes.label: EMA (Exponential Moving Average)
nodes.rationale: EMA_DECAY=0.999 tracks parameters AND BatchNorm buffers (running mean/var are EMA'd, num_batches_tracked copied). Removing the buffer sync produces checkpoints with stale BN statistics that silently degrade validation accuracy and every exported model.

nodes.label: Knowledge distillation
nodes.rationale: Teacher accuracy in the student at zero on-device cost — student keeps the lite2 architecture, size, and latency. Defaults KD_ALPHA=0.7, KD_TEMPERATURE=4.0.

nodes.label: QAT phase 3 (opt-in)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in because Android INT8 now comes from converter-side PTQ; QAT is only a recovery tool when converter PTQ drops more than ~2 pts. Uses per-tensor observers and starts from the best phase-2 EMA checkpoint.

nodes.label: soft_ce (soft cross-entropy)
nodes.rationale: Supports fractional label vectors produced by CutMix/MixUp mixed labels.

nodes.label: SOTA optimizations
nodes.rationale: AdamW weight_decay=1e-2, linear warmup -> cosine annealing, label smoothing 0.05, gradient accumulation 2 steps, gradient clipping max_norm=1.0.

nodes.norm_label: training internals & data flow — deep reference

nodes.label: CutMix / MixUp batch mixing on GPU
nodes.norm_label: cutmix / mixup batch mixing on gpu

nodes.label: Effective-number-of-samples WeightedRandomSampler (beta=0.999)
nodes.rationale: Softens pure inverse-frequency oversampling that would repeat 5-image breeds excessively, while still balancing rare breeds.

nodes.label: Weight EMA including BN buffers
nodes.rationale: EMA must update BatchNorm running stats (and hard-copy num_batches_tracked) in addition to parameters, otherwise exported phase-2 checkpoints carry stale BN stats while validation still looks plausible.

nodes.label: Knowledge distillation (teacher to student)
nodes.rationale: Distill a lite4 teacher into the unchanged lite2 student ((1-a)*hard CE + a*T^2*KL, a=0.7, T=4.0) to get teacher accuracy at zero on-device cost.

nodes.label: Mobile input convention: RGB float32 [0,1] with normalization baked in
nodes.norm_label: mobile input convention: rgb float32 [0,1] with normalization baked in
nodes.rationale: ImageNet normalization is baked into the mobile graphs so the Flutter app's existing pixel/255 preprocessing is exactly correct with zero app changes; outputs read by index 0=binary, 1=cattle, 2=buffalo.

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime Mobile INT8 (QDQ static quantization)
nodes.norm_label: onnx runtime mobile int8 (qdq static quantization)

nodes.label: Parity gate (fp32 vs mobile INT8 accuracy check)
nodes.norm_label: parity gate (fp32 vs mobile int8 accuracy check)
nodes.rationale: INT8 must stay within 1 pt combined_top1 of fp32; --synthetic N allows artifact-only logit parity when no dataset is available.

nodes.label: Quantization-Aware Training (opt-in phase 3)
nodes.rationale: QAT is opt-in with per-tensor observers because it is only an x86 accuracy-recovery tool; mobile INT8 comes from converter-side PTQ and phase-3 checkpoints cannot be re-exported.

nodes.label: 3-head multi-task classifier (binary + cattle + buffalo)
nodes.rationale: Heads are always sized 57 cattle + 18 buffalo regardless of data mode, so the architecture is identical across smoke/half/quarter/full training; unused outputs simply receive no gradient.
